label: Выход
description: A 10-sentence usage card for выход (exit; way out).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Выход' is the nominative subject of 'находится'. The phrase 'справа от вас' locates the exit, with 'вас' in the genitive after 'от'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. As an inanimate masculine, 'выход' is unchanged in the accusative as the object of 'нашли'. 'Наконец' adds relief, fitting both literal and figurative senses.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. The word 'нет' takes the genitive 'выхода', here meaning a way out. 'Из этой ситуации' uses the genitive after 'из'.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. The preposition 'к' takes the dative, giving 'выходу'. 'Все' is the nominative subject heading toward the exit.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after воспользоваться. The verb 'воспользоваться' requires the instrumental, giving 'выходом'. 'Единственным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'в' the noun takes the prepositional form 'выходе'. 'Нет смысла' uses the genitive for absence, judging the solution pointless.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in a question. 'Выход' is the nominative subject of 'находится'. 'Запасной' is the agreeing masculine adjective meaning emergency exit.
Strategic focus: Genitive after у. The preposition 'у' takes the genitive, giving 'выхода'. The clause places the subjects beside the exit, and 'долго' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after несколько. The quantity word 'несколько' takes the genitive plural 'выходов'. 'Запасных' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate in the figurative sense. 'Выход' is nominative as the predicate after 'это', meaning a way out. 'Из положения' is genitive, completing the idiom.
